system.description:
By talking to her victim, the Setite can instill an irrational fear of a certain object, substance, person or condition. The object of the phobia can be broad (cars) or very specific (pink '79 Fords), so long as the victim can recognize and distinguish what the vampire wants him to fear.

You must win a Mental Challenge against the target character to instill a Phobia for a scene. Repeated challenges can make the change permanent by winning as many times as the target's Courage rating; a permanent Phobia may only be overcome as if it were a Derangement.
system.source: Clanbook: Followers of Set, Chapter Two
system.duration: One scene, or indefinite if repeated challenges succeed
